//: Exists solely to typecheck the published index.d.ts, which nothing else covers: ESLint skips .d.ts files and the runtime tests only assert the file exists on disk.

skipLibCheck stays false on purpose. index.d.ts is itself a declaration file, so turning it on would skip the only file this config exists to check and make `yarn typecheck` a no-op that always passes.

noImplicitAny is off because skipLibCheck: false pulls semantic-release's own declarations into the program, and those import the untyped `signale` package. That is a defect in a dependency's types, not in ours, and the one error class not fixable from here. Every other `strict` check still applies to index.d.ts.
Prose lives in this root key rather than JSONC comments because TypeScript rejects unknown keys inside compilerOptions and the pretty-format-json pre-commit hook rejects comments in .json files.
